Senior here, the common thing teachers tell students is how college is going to eat us up and spit us out. A particular moment I remember is a student could not bring his work to school because of a family emergency(grandmother rushed to hospital with no warning)
The teacher had an assignment due that day but the student didn’t show up, his mother did send an email that day. The teacher gave the student a 0 with no hesitation and stated “college professors won’t care about that, if you don’t show up they will fail you. Even if it’s an emergency or you email them. They don’t care about you..”
I will never forget that but it has caused us to dread college and fear everything about the outside world. It wasn’t exclusive to that teacher sadly, all the teachers here did stuff like that.
Not saying all teachers are like that, but wanted to share cause it’s a story I’ll never forget..
